![Hooded Parrot](image/gouldian_finch.jpg)
We are investigating occurrence data of [**Gouldian finch**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gouldian_finch) in Australia from the **Atlas of Living Australia**, and make a map showing the spatial locations of sightings from 2014 to 2024.

```{r echo=FALSE}
# global variables
organism_name <- "gouldian_finch"
organism_title <- "Gouldian finch"
taxa     <- "Gouldian finch"
start    <- 2014
end      <- 2024
```


```{r "request data ALA", eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}

organism <- obs_data(taxa, start, end) |> polished_data()
# Save data
mysave(organism_name, organism)
```


This is the head of data set:

```{r "print head of data", echo=FALSE}
organism <- myload(organism_name)
organism |> slice_head(n = 3) |> as_tibble() 
```

Now we want to know the number of occurrence in each state:

```{r "number of occ in state", echo=FALSE}
organism |> my_count(scientificName, obs_state, f=1) |> as_tibble() 
```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
# Clean and prepare data
organism |> plot_map1(color_by = scientificName)

```

#### Weekly Distribution of organism

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
organism |>  plot_bar_week()
```

#### Monthly Distribution of organism

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
organism |> plot_bar_month()
```

#### Yearly Distribution of organism

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
organism |> plot_bar_year()
```

#### Nearest Weather Station Mapping

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
attach_nearest_station(organism_name)
```

```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
organism_ws <- myload_ws(organism_name)

head(organism_ws, n = 2) |> as_tibble()
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

summarize_state_frequencies(organism_name)

```


Interpretation:

-    Queensland:\
    77 of your organism records were observed in Queensland.\
    However, only 81 of those were linked to weather stations also located in Queensland.


-   Western Australia:\
    951 observations occurred there,\
    But 989 records were linked to weather stations in Western Australia — suggesting many observations from other states were matched to Western Australia stations.
